# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. This isn't passive Christianity—it's active, deliberate, and courageous. The word "watchful" calls us to vigilance, because our enemy prowls around seeking someone to devour (1 Peter 5:8). Standing firm requires roots—deep conviction built on Scripture, not shifting opinions. Acting like men means taking responsibility, leading with humility, and refusing to shrink back when the culture pressures us to compromise. And being strong isn't about physical might—it's about moral and spiritual fortitude forged in prayer, discipline, and brotherhood.

Too many men drift through life spiritually asleep, reacting to circumstances instead of standing on truth. Today, you have a choice: coast or contend. Strength isn't born in comfort—it's built in the daily grind of showing up, pressing in, and refusing to quit. Your family, your church, and your community need men who will stand firm. So lace up. The battle is real, but so is your God.
## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups—each rep a declaration: "I will stand firm." Then spend 5 minutes in prayer asking God for vigilance and courage today.
